prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1282; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with the declarations pages for each. Please also confirm whether a claim has been opened and provide the claim number and the name of the assigned adjuster.

Your company is hereby placed on notice to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim file notes, and any communications with the parties or witnesses. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
